scope: P4 default bounded seed0 pilot successor; training phase; train/validation only
launch_conditions: canonical pipeline gate state rechecked at launch
single-job serialization, shared resource locks, owned-process barrier, and aggregate 72-hour budget guard pass

candidate_accounting.interpretation: 16 jobs are four mandatory variants replicated across four datasets under shared g00/m00; they are not 16 hyperparameter candidates. Any scientific hyperparameter change requires a new candidate ID and consumes a slot. No reset of the 12-candidate maximum.

design.unchanged_hyperparameter_reference: configs/core-development-v1; each config preserves all task, model and training values except output_dir, explicit training_candidate_tensor/cache settings.

data_binding: Configs plus protocol/source files are hashed here. Dataset arrays were not loaded or hashed. At launch, mandatory input binding must hash actual dataset files and source/config dependencies, then verify after the run.
formal_reuse_rule: Seed0 results may be reused for formal reporting only if selected source, data binding, configuration and final selection all match; otherwise rerun under the formal queue. These pilots do not constitute five-seed results.
